http://rforge.net/JGR/files/

and double clicking on it.


ian

messages.subject: Re: Install Deducer on Win 7
parts:
Sorry for the gap between responses, but I am in the middle of
something else. I think you are probably correct about the versions.
Here is what I suggest:

1. Uninstall both versions of R, and make sure the library at
C:/Program Files/R/R-2.15.1/library is deleted
2. Install R 2.15.2 from CRAN
3. Open R and run install.packages("Deducer")
4. Delete any hidden preference files in your home directory (you can
use the rm command in the command prompt). They are named .JGRprefsrc
and .JGREditorprefsrc.
5. Run JGR.exe
6. Cross fingers

Best,
Ian
